authority.restoration_manifest: PostgreSQL restoration authority row plus immutable MinIO object manifest
authority.pcap_cut_role: source evidence selection only; a cut PCAP is never a restored file

unapproved_protocol_policy.manifest_requirement: record metadata-only terminal manifest with exact observed protocol and profile rejection reason
unapproved_protocol_policy.claim: no protocol outside approved_protocol_profiles is restored

tcp_reassembly.container_selection: traffic.sessions authorizes tenant/probe/session/community/primary-flow/time; manifest-v2 PCAP containers are selected by tenant, probe, and dual-unit-compatible time overlap before exact five-tuple filtering inside verified object bytes
tcp_reassembly.canonical_direction: same canonical A-to-B and B-to-A semantics as traffic.v1.FlowEvent identity_revision=2
tcp_reassembly.duplicate_policy: identical retransmission is deduplicated; overlapping unequal bytes are corrupt
tcp_reassembly.gap_policy: record exact missing sequence ranges and never fill bytes
tcp_reassembly.capture_truncation_policy: captured_len less than original_len marks affected application message truncated
tcp_reassembly.event_time_policy: source capture timestamps only; processing time is telemetry
tcp_reassembly.source_proof: every emitted byte maps to one or more source packet sequence and object byte ranges

rules.complete: approved profile framing completed, no source gaps or capture truncation, decoded length is within policy, and staged object SHA matches the committed receipt
rules.partial: approved framing is identifiable and visible bytes are coherent, but one or more TCP sequence ranges are missing; missing ranges are recorded and no bytes are invented
rules.truncated: a source record has captured_len below original_len or capture end occurs before the declared application boundary
rules.corrupt: overlapping retransmissions disagree, framing is contradictory, bounded decode fails, or staged and committed content hashes disagree
rules.oversize: declared or observed output exceeds tenant, task, protocol, expansion-ratio, part-count, or object-size limits
rules.unsupported: protocol, version, direction, transfer mode, framing, encoding, or encryption is outside the approved profile

required_invariants: tenant_id is present and matches every source and object authority record
content_sha256 is lowercase SHA-256 whenever an object is present
packet_ranges and tcp_sequence_ranges are sorted non-overlapping canonical ranges
complete requires one trusted object receipt and no missing_ranges
non-complete status never claims restored completeness
executable automatic_open and automatic_decompress are always false

steps: validate tenant-scoped request, approved profile, time window, quota, retention, and idempotency key
load only immutable PCAP objects whose tenant, bucket, key, version, size, and sha256 match the index receipt
reassemble bounded streams and classify one terminal status without executing payload bytes
stream an allowed object form to a tenant quarantine key while computing wire and content SHA-256
HEAD the exact bucket, key, version, size, etag, and checksum to obtain a trusted receipt
commit restoration manifest, terminal status, object receipt, audit fact, and outbox fact in one PostgreSQL transaction
make downloads eligible only after the committed manifest and tenant authorization both succeed

crash_recovery.before_object_receipt: no authority manifest; retry same idempotency key or remove untrusted multipart upload
crash_recovery.after_object_receipt_before_manifest: record as orphan candidate and reconcile by exact tenant/key/version/hash; never expose
crash_recovery.after_manifest_commit: idempotent replay returns the existing revision and exact receipt without rewriting object bytes
crash_recovery.manifest_without_object: terminal integrity failure; block download and enqueue reconciliation

safety_limits.path_policy: wire filenames are metadata only; object keys derive from tenant and restoration identity, never from an untrusted path
safety_limits.archive_policy: never automatically expand archives or nested message containers
safety_limits.execution_policy: restored and quarantine objects are inert bytes and are never executed, rendered inline as active content, or passed to a shell
safety_limits.download_policy: tenant-scoped authorization and immutable download audit are mandatory; corrupt objects are evidence-only

compatibility_and_rollout.pcap_cut_api: unchanged and explicitly separate from restoration
compatibility_and_rollout.consumer_first: deploy an idle manifest reader and status-aware UI before enabling a restoration writer
compatibility_and_rollout.mixed_version: unknown protocol profile or manifest field is preserved or rejected as unsupported; never guessed
compatibility_and_rollout.rollback: stop restoration admission, drain or quarantine active tasks, retain committed manifests and objects, disable worker, and keep PCAP cutting available
compatibility_and_rollout.activation_gate: all required approver signatures plus N016 implementation, N017 malicious corpus, tenant/object negative tests, and default-off deployment proof

claims.allowed: versioned default-off contract for bounded approved protocol restoration semantics
